thesis: Matt Brown argues that finance and business are fundamentally about people and communication rather than just numbers and spreadsheets. He explains that his career path, which began as an accidental financial advisor and included a decade in alternative asset management distribution, provided the necessary foundation to build Case, a two-sided platform designed to solve inefficiencies in how complex investment strategies are delivered to financial advisors and institutional investors.
